about: One table for "finished and not seen yet", read by BOTH sides: digest.rs's Card::unseen_work over seen_epoch (its test), and afterglow.ts's isUnread over seenEpoch (app/scripts/afterglow-check.mjs, the real TS). worked/seen/opened are the declared store's last_worked_epoch, last_seen_epoch and last_opened_epoch; null is absent. Change the rule on one side and that side's check goes red here.

cases.why: a zero stamp is no work
seen exactly at the finish is seen
an open stands in for a look
the later of the two wins: open
the later of the two wins: seen
